text_blocks.snippet: A sore throat is a common symptom of COVID-19, sometimes occurring as one of the first signs, according to GoHealth Urgent Care. Other symptoms that may accompany a sore throat with COVID-19 include a runny nose, cough, body aches, fever, and fatigue. The sore throat associated with the Omicron subvariant NB.1.8.1 (Nimbus) is often described as particularly painful, sometimes compared to a "razor blade". If the sore throat worsens or doesn't improve within 48 hours, it's recommended to seek medical attention to rule out other potential causes like mono or influenza.
